content.stem: 已对现有虚拟资产服务提供商(VASP)客户完成定期审查.以下哪些是潜在洗钱活动的迹象？(选择三项.)

options.A: 利用空壳公司向虚拟资产服务提供商(VASP)存入和提取资金
options.B: 利用对等网络来降低与服务器维护和数据存储相关的成本
options.C: 市场的快速波动导致标的资产价值迅速变化
options.D: 频繁使用混币器和翻滚器持有资产并进行交易
options.E: 接受来自以反洗钱法规和框架薄弱著称的国家的资金

content.stem_en: A periodic review has been completed for an existing virtual asset service provider (VASP) customer. Which of the following are indicators of potential money laundering? (Select three.)

options_en.A: Use of shell companies for deposits and withdrawals into the VASP.
options_en.B: Using a peer-to-peer network to reduce costs associated with server maintenance and data storage.
options_en.C: Rapid market fluctuations resulting in quick changes in the value of underlying assets.
options_en.D: Frequent use of mixers and tumblers for holdings and transactions.
options_en.E: Receiving funds from countries known for weak money laundering regulations and frameworks.

content.raw_question_en: -[Risks and Methods of Money Laundering and Terrorist F inancing] A periodic review has been completed for an existing virtual asset service provider (VASP) customer.
